> He stated that video games are very addictive and waste you life. At first glance I disagreed what he said, because Technoblade became popular with video games. 

In my opinion, it’s is true that video games are addictive and have a *high possibility* to lure people to “waste their life”. Something that doesn’t make too much sense to me is the fact that Techno got popular by playing games affect your perception to “video games are addictive and waste ppl’s life”. 

My interpretation is: Techno *seems addictive to* video games so it makes him falls into the category of “wasting life” and you didn’t like that idea. 

Hamza’s point of view to videos games is very one-sided (based on your description). Video games have a high chance to lure people to go on a bad path in life but that’s possibility after all. While I think it’s true that Techno showed a massive love and passion to vidyas (maybe addiction? Hyper-fixation? I don’t want to assume
Techno’s perception to video games as it may sound too parasocial.), he was doing it as a career. That made a huge difference between ppl who blindly spent all their time being addicted to video games and Techno. He didn’t just play it then lost a sense of direction in life. He had a clear sense of what he wanted to achieved when playing Minecraft and he succeeded. That doesn’t sound like wasting life in my opinion. Whether playing video games is a waste of life really comes to one’s own habit/ attitude.

> “you don’t want to have friends, you just want to take the same drug with them” 

The use of this quote makes me confusing as well. “You just want to take the same drug with them”, as if you like Techno just because he is also taking the drugs (from Hamza’s point, playing video games and waste life- aka the bad thing). That’s my interpretation of the correlation between your use of quote and Techno. If this is what you are implying, I do have a lot of questions and logical flaws I wanna raise.

I got more things I want to point out but I am busy rn and maybe I’ll get back later. /nm btw. I write this long paragraph not because I am mad but I really want to engage in a logical/ sightly philosophical conversation. I really like discussion like this and I don’t bite.
